title: Oligofection of small interfering RNAs in senescent human fibroblasts
protocol: Plate 15-20x10^3 cells per coverslip 2 days before oligofection.
Mix 175 μl Optimem + 1-10 μl siRNA oligos (200 nM) per coverslip.
Mix 11 μl Optimem + 4 μl Oligofectamine per coverslip and leave for 7 minutes.
Combine solutions from steps 3 and 4, leaving the mixture for 15 minutes.
Change the medium of senescent cells by removing old medium and adding 800 μl Optimem per coverslip.
Add the mix obtained in step 4 to senescent cells already in 800 μl Optimem.
Leave cells in the incubator for at least 4 hours.
Without removing the Optimem medium, add 1 ml of culture medium without antibiotics and with 20% FCS or FBS.
